lane:
سدغ

سُدْغٌ a dial. var. of صُدْغٌ, (K,) which is the more common. (TA. [See the latter.])

مسدغ مِسْدَغٌ : see what follows.

مسدغة مِسْدَغَةٌ a dial. var. of مِصْدَغَةٌ [q. v.]; (TA;) as also مِزْدَغَةٌ; (L and TA in art. زدغ;) and ↓مِسْدَغٌ and مِزْدَغٌ signify the same [as dial. vars. of مِصْدَغٌ]. (TA.)
